import pandas as pd

# Load the pollen_openness_score dataset
pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')

# Convert the 'CE' column to numeric
pollen_df['CE'] = pd.to_numeric(pollen_df['CE'], errors='coerce')

# Filter the data for the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE)
young_bronze_age_df = pollen_df[(pollen_df['CE'] >= -1100) & (pollen_df['CE'] <= -500)]

# Filter the data for the beginning of the Younger Bronze Age (1100 BCE)
beginning_young_bronze_age_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['CE'] == -1100]

# Filter the data for the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE)
subsequent_time_horizons_df = young_bronze_age_df[young_bronze_age_df['CE'] < -1100]

# Calculate the mean PC1 values for the beginning of the Younger Bronze Age and the subsequent time horizons
beginning_mean_pc1 = beginning_young_bronze_age_df['Belau_PC1'].mean()
subsequent_mean_pc1 = subsequent_time_horizons_df['Belau_PC1'].mean()

beginning_mean_pc1, subsequent_mean_pc1
